title: A 27-Pound Rock From Space Smashed Into a Parked Car in 1992

scenes.text: In 1992, a rock from space crashed into a parked car in New York.
A fireball crossed the sky from Kentucky to New York.
Cameras filming high school football games caught it.
At 7:50 p.m., a twenty-seven-pound piece punched through the trunk of a parked Chevy Malibu in Peekskill.
Those videos let scientists trace its path.
The car cost three hundred dollars. It later sold for ten thousand.

description:
On October 9th, 1992, a 27-pound meteorite went through the trunk of a parked Chevy Malibu in Peekskill, New York.
Football cameras filmed the fireball, helping scientists work out its path.
Would you buy the car?
